Implemented artifact-centric evaluator entrypoint in services/evaluation/evaluator.py, added fallback needs_critique path for missing artifact metadata, expanded unit coverage, and added tests/run_evaluation_smoke.py. Verified with pytest -q services/evaluation/tests and python3 tests/run_evaluation_smoke.py.

Review changes requested: evaluator fallback/partial-metadata path emits schema-invalid target_artifact_type='unknown'; evaluator also permits empty score_components even though evaluator_result.schema.json requires at least one component. Fix contract enforcement and add schema-level regression tests, then re-handoff for review.

Fixed evaluator contract enforcement: fallback and partial-metadata paths now require a valid target_artifact_type, empty score_components now raise, and schema regression tests were added. Verified with pytest services/evaluation/tests/test_evaluator.py and python3 tests/run_evaluation_smoke.py.
Review approved: evaluator core path, schema enforcement, and smoke coverage verified. Owner may finalize to done.
